title: False-alarm calibration transport across engines in full-flight aero-engine anomaly detection (N-CMAPSS): code, frozen protocols and evidence

creators.name: Mei, Jinghang
creators.affiliation: School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, The University of Sydney

description:
Research code, frozen protocols, calibration-only locks, one-shot audit records, derived outputs and an evidence ledger for an audit of nominal healthy false-alarm calibration in full-flight aero-engine anomaly detection on the NASA N-CMAPSS benchmark. The release contains the DS02 discovery and the one-shot DS03 confirmation (unchanged from v1.0.0), separately frozen post-confirmation analyses, a frozen multi-subset extension over seven previously unopened subsets (five fleet families, 30 held-out audit engines; pooled, retrospective phase-conditioned and continuous-context calibration, a condition-aware CVAE baseline, a fixed-volume calibration-fleet composition intervention and alarm-persistence rules), an internal hostile review and a final author-approved focused validation (cross-fitted self-calibration references, a calibration-class-preserving bootstrap and five-flight local recalibration).

It accompanies the manuscript “False-Alarm Calibration Transport Across Engines in Full-Flight Aero-Engine Anomaly Detection: A Multi-Subset Audit of Context Conditioning and Calibration-Fleet Coverage” (prepared for Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing). Raw NASA data are not redistributed.
